resources.string: Extra features, each with its own switch
Read chats without the sender seeing two ticks
With ghost mode on, messages still look unread to the other person, even after you read them. They may notice you reply without the ticks turning blue.
More extras arrive here in the next updates: music, videos, calls, Vault and Customise.
Remove this chat from your music sources? The songs stay in the chat.
Songs from these chats make up your library. Tap a chat to remove it.
No songs found in the chosen chats yet.
Remove this chat from your video sources? The videos stay in the chat.
Videos from these chats make up your library. Tap a chat to remove it.
No videos found in the chosen chats yet.
Pick chats and channels inside each library; their songs and videos appear there.
Never show you as online. You may appear "last seen recently".
Messages others delete stay in your chats on this phone
What should I remind you about?
Reminders arrive in Saved Messages at the chosen time and can repeat daily, weekly or monthly. For exact timing, allow "Alarms & reminders" for Riv Post in Android settings.
True black everywhere while a dark theme is on
Green bars and bubbles while a light theme is on
No stories above the chat list
No ads at the bottom of big channels
Open a chat again after changing the look. Some screens pick up colours after reopening the app.
Keeps a small connection open so messages arrive when the app is closed
Riv Post can\'t use the official app\'s push service, so this connection does that job. If notifications still arrive late, turn off battery optimisation for Riv Post in Android settings.
